fieldValues.title: I-133 has three clauses; only one (the sibling-keys cross-check) had no enforcement anywhere
fieldValues.summary: The attribution cell's dispatch text (srs#650) framed I-133 as a single shape rule, but the record's normative_statement actually has three independent clauses: (1) fieldMeta keys are a subset of the sibling fieldValues keys, (2) each fieldMeta value has shape {source?, editedAt?, sourceRefs?}, (3) fieldMeta must not appear inside an inline-composite value. Clause (2) is already fully enforced by validate-records.mjs's existing schema pass against docs/schema/2.0/record.json's FieldMeta $def (additionalProperties:false, source enum, editedAt date-time format) - it runs on every corpus record already, under the pre-existing validate-records check (cell: conformance), not a new one. Only clause (1), a cross-property key-subset constraint plain JSON Schema cannot express, was genuinely unguarded.
evidence: docs/schema/2.0/record.json $defs.FieldMeta: additionalProperties:false, source enum [human,ai,imported,derived], editedAt format:date-time
scripts/checks.json validate-records entry: cell conformance, validates every srs/records/** instance against record.json via scripts/lib/json-schema-lite.mjs
scripts/lib/json-schema-lite.mjs has no keyword for a cross-property key-subset constraint (verified by reading resolveRef/validateAgainstSchema - no such check exists)

Corpus measurement (scripts/check-attribution-cell.mjs, srs#650/PR#660): 527 Record instances, exactly 1 carries a fieldMeta block (rfc-004's proposal_artifact_path), and its one key is a real fieldValues key
fieldValues.body: Relevant to any future unit dispatched from a grid-census cell read-out that names a corpus statement as unenforced: check whether the statement's full text has multiple clauses before assuming the whole statement is uncovered, and check whether general schema validation (validate-package.mjs/validate-records.mjs via json-schema-lite.mjs) already covers part of it before writing a new cell-specific check.
